column1: # Groups of the cardinal of Tortosa's cipher, 1520-1521.
# group: the letters as written, without the closing dot. docs/METHOD.md says how r and z, and
#   q and g, are distinguished in this hand.
# source K = Kolosova's thesis, vocabulary of "cifra 4", pp. 249-250. The thesis gives each group
#   as a picture cut from the manuscript.
#   Its values are in modern spelling. Here they are in the spelling of the letters where the
#   two differ (ahun, assi, deve, quando, Magestad), and without accents; tid. is given there as
#   so/çu. The thesis has mu. only in the pair cim. mu., vuestra Magestad; mu. alone for Magestad
#   is taken from that pair, since cim. alone is vuestra in the vocabulary.
# source S = found in this study from Simancas letters whose deciphered text is known:
#   A = AGS PTR,LEG,2,1,99 (5 Dec 1521; cipher images 1-5, decipherment of 1521 images 9-10)
#   B = AGS PTR,LEG,2,1,100 images 3-5 (undated sheet wholly in cipher; its text is the cipher
#       paragraphs of the letter of 24 Oct 1521 as printed in Danvila, vol. 4, pp. 547-549)
#   C = AGS PTR,LEG,2,1,101 (7 Dec 1521; cipher images 1-2, decipherment of 1521 image 3)
#   D = AGS PTR,LEG,2,1,76 image 5 (a cipher paragraph written into the duplicate of the letter
#       of 6 May 1521; Danvila prints its text deciphered as the third cipher paragraph of the
#   For the ten groups the paragraph needs, and for the four other added groups that the test
#   passages use (co., sae., dob., cog.), the "where" column gives the image and the line of
#   each place whose text the check spells with the key, what is written there and the
#   deciphered text, as "tokens = text", with "and" between two items at the same place and
#   "; " between places. Further places of co., sae. and dob. in A follow in brackets, by image
#   only. docs/METHOD.md says how the lines are counted. For the other added groups the column
# The values were fixed before the test passage (data/test_passage.tsv) was transcribed. After
# the test 23 groups were respelt, in this file and in the transcriptions together (round r,
# tailed z, q for g, cim. for cm., rug. and rof.), Kolosova's qad. was entered, ga. and ge.
# lost their marks of doubt, four groups whose places had not been checked again were removed,
# and a second place, B image 5 line 13, was entered for gad. No group changed its word.
